systems.tiers: In growing use centrally; the budget support partners ask in November 2025 that its extension and interoperability at municipal level be speeded up, so it is not yet extended to the municipalities

note: Budget Support Group communiqué on its mission of 20 to 28 November 2025. Its municipal points are that e-procurement has still to be extended to municipal level, that the Court of Auditors audited municipalities and that social-income coordination with municipalities must improve; nothing is said of any municipal office's connection.
